notes.title: Collection Update 0.95
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p]In this update, we've added a new Collection feature that allows you to review the details of cards and relics you've encountered in the game. Since older save files didn’t store collection data, players will still need to reveal encountered items as they play, sorry for the inconvenience![/p][p]We've also been working on new content and features based on your feedback. Stay tuned for future updates![/p][p][/p][p][b]Here is the full changelog:[/b][/p][p] [/p][h3]New Features[/h3][list][*][p]Added new Collection feature for cards and relics⭐[/p][/*][*][p]You can now play cards using number row on the keyboard[/p][/*][*][p]Camera movement can now be controlled by dragging with the right mouse button[/p][/*][*][p]Added an animation effect to highlight card cost changes in the hand[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Balance Adjustments[/h3][list][*][p]Adjusted the way card costs are modified by some relics and spell cards to better match expectations[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the strength of early enemies in Act II and Act III to smooth out difficulty spikes[/p][/*][*][p]Lowered the base HP of buildings, but now buildings gain HP when upgraded, making upgrade-focused strategies more viable[/p][list][*][p]Small buildings gain 100 HP per upgrade, large buildings gain 200 HP[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Improved the survivability of the Goddess Statue:[/p][list][*][p]Goddess Statue HP: 500 → 1000[/p][/*][*][p]Plating (the Goddess Statue’s self-protection skill) now provides a fixed 1000 shield each time it triggers[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Hatch[/b], [b]Clairvoyance[/b], and [b]Lightning Shield [/b]now have larger area[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the range indicators for [b]Rebirth Totem[/b] and [b]Watch Totem[/b] didn’t match their actual effect range[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the shop icon at the top of the screen disappeared before the end of a turn[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the banner image was not correctly displaying for different goddesses on the game result screen[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Balance Update 0.92
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p]A huge thank you to all players who supported Aurora Defense at launch! We deeply appreciate your invaluable feedback and suggestions.[/p][p]We’ve heard your concerns about balance and gameplay experience. In this update, we’ve fixed and optimized some of the more obvious issues. We’re also actively considering bigger system changes to enhance the fun and lay the groundwork for future content updates.[/p][p]Here is what's changed:[/p][h2]New Features[/h2][list][*][p]You can now use the [b]Inspect Field[/b] function (bottom-left corner) while receiving battle rewards or choosing building upgrades. This lets you check your current base and upgrade status to help make smarter decisions.[/p][/*][*][p]Building cards now show an icon indicating how many tiles it occupies.[/p][/*][*][p]Before dismantling a building, the tooltip will now show how many Crystals will be refunded.[/p][/*][*][p]A title is now displayed at the start of each Act.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Optimizations and Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]When buildings and units overlap, selecting will now prioritize the building.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]Mirror Crystal[/b] could summon from destroyed summoning buildings.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where players could sometimes receive extra [b]Magic Crystal[/b] cards at the start of a turn.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing Crystal income prediction on the final turn of an Act.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved descriptions for some cards and relics.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Balance Adjustments[/h2][h3]General[/h3][list][*][p]Adjusted the starting decks for all Goddesses to better focus on their faction identities.[/p][/*][*][p]Buffed the [b]Plating[/b] ability on the [b]Goddess Statue[/b] (its self-protection skill).[/p][/*][*][p]Starting Crystals reduced from 6 to 5, but the Goddess level upgrades now affect turn 1 Crystal.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the movement speed bonus from upgrades.[/p][/*][*][p]Smoothed out the difficulty curve to improve pacing across a run.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Earth Faction[/h3][p][i]Tortoise was too strong in the current version, making the game less challenging. We’ve reduced its HP to lower its durability while increasing its base damage to keep it relevant in combat.[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Tortoise[/b] HP: 400 → 300[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tortoise[/b] ATK: 20 → 30[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tortoise[/b] Attack Interval: 0.9 → 1.3[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tortoise[/b] Defense upgrade rarity: Epic → Rare[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sunstone[/b] upgrade effect: 10% → 5%[/p][/*][*][p][b]Moonstone[/b] upgrade effect: 10% → 5%[/p][/*][*][p][b]Mirror Crystal[/b] summon interval: 12 → 20[/p][/*][/list][h3]Fire Faction[/h3][p][i]We’ve increased the number of fire units on the battlefield and boosted the Phoenix’s attack power.[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Firebird Nest[/b] summon time: 5 → 4.5[/p][/*][*][p][b]Firefeather Stand[/b] summon time: 7.5 → 7[/p][/*][*][p][b]Phoenix Altar[/b] Crystal cost: 5 → 4[/p][/*][*][p][b]Phoenix[/b] HP: 80 → 60[/p][/*][*][p][b]Phoenix[/b] ATK: 20 → 24[/p][/*][/list][h3]Lightning Faction[/h3][p][i]Lightning units now have faster attack speeds, and Thunder Tiger has gained Evasion to improve survivability.[/i][/p][list][*][p][b]Thunder Guard[/b] Attack Interval: 2.4 → 2.2[/p][/*][*][p][b]Thunder Eye[/b] Attack Interval: 2.8 → 2.5[/p][/*][*][p][b]Thunder Eye[/b] Range: 2.8 → 3[/p][/*][*][p][b]Thunder Tiger[/b] HP: 300 → 250[/p][/*][*][p][b]Thunder Tiger[/b] Attack Interval: 1.8 → 1.2[/p][/*][*][p][b]Thunder Tiger[/b] now starts with 30% Evasion.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Thunder Tiger[/b] max-level upgrade now grants increased attack speed and Evasion chance.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ruins Workshop[/b] defense range: 4.5 → 5[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ruins Observatory[/b] defense range: 5.7 → 6[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ruins Temple[/b] defense range: 6.8 → 7[/p][/*][/list][h3]Magic Faction[/h3][list][*][p][b]Faerie Drake Nest[/b] defense range: 4.5 → 5.5[/p][/*][*][p][b]Beast Sanctuary[/b] defense range: 4.5 → 7[/p][/*][/list][h3]Enemies[/h3][list][*][p][b]Void Husk[/b] DEF: 15 → 10[/p][/*][*][p][b]Wrath[/b] HP: 350 → 300[/p][/*][*][p][b]Abyss Worm[/b] attack range: 3 → 2[/p][/*][/list][h3]Spell Cards[/h3][list][*][p][b]Reforge[/b] Crystal cost: 0 → 2; removed Crystal gain effect[/p][/*][*][p][b]Magic Grimoire[/b] notes.title: Demo Update v0.53
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who joined the playtest during the Next Fest October 2024 and provided valuable feedback!

In this small patch, we've implemented a few small fixes and optimizations to the demo:

[olist]
[*] Improved Hint Display: In-game hints are now clearer, helping players quickly understand the current battle situation.
[*] Crystal Value Fix: Fixed an issue where the crystal value color displayed incorrectly after using a magic card to restore crystals.
[*] Sound Volume Adjustment: Adjusted the sound volume balance.
[*] Updated  New Lightning Attack Sound: Updated the sound effect for lightning attacks.
[*] Added Mouse Lock Cursor Setting: A new toggle for locking the cursor has been added to the settings menu.
[/olist]

Additionally, based on the valuable feedback received during the festival, we're working on developing new content, which will be added to the demo in future updates. 
Stay tuned for details and updates, more information soon!
